running_services.name: Services (Auto-Start)
running_services.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Service | Where-Object { $_.State -eq 'Running' -or $_.StartMode -eq 'Auto' } | Select-Object Name, DisplayName, State, StartMode, PathName | Sort-Object Name | ConvertTo-Csv -NoTypeInformation

listening_ports.name: Listening Ports
listening_ports.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Select-Object LocalPort, @{N='ProcessName';E={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProcessName}}, @{N='Path';E={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Path}} | Sort-Object LocalPort -Unique | ConvertTo-Csv -NoTypeInformation

installed_packages.name: Installed Software
installed_packages.command: Get-Package -ProviderName Programs, msi -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Version | Sort-Object Name | ConvertTo-Csv -NoTypeInformation

containers.name: Docker Containers
containers.command: if (Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'RUNTIME=docker'; docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}	{{.Image}}	{{.Status}}	{{.Ports}}' 2>$null } else { 'NOT_INSTALLED' }

scheduled_tasks.name: Scheduled Tasks
scheduled_tasks.command: Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object { $_.State -ne 'Disabled' -and $_.TaskPath -notmatch '^\\Microsoft' } | Select-Object TaskName, TaskPath, State, @{N='Author';E={$_.Principal.UserId}} | ConvertTo-Csv -NoTypeInformation

network_interfaces.name: Network Interfaces
network_interfaces.command: Get-NetIPAddress | Where-Object { $_.AddressFamily -eq 'IPv4' -and $_.IPAddress -ne '127.0.0.1' } | Select-Object InterfaceAlias, IPAddress, PrefixLength | ConvertTo-Csv -NoTypeInformation

mounted_filesystems.name: Drives & Volumes
mounted_filesystems.command: '[VOLUMES]'; Get-Volume | Where-Object { $_.DriveLetter -or $_.FileSystemLabel } | Select-Object DriveLetter, FileSystemLabel, FileSystem, HealthStatus, @{N='SizeGB';E={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,1)}}, @{N='FreeGB';E={[math]::Round($_.SizeRemaining/1GB,1)}} | ConvertTo-Csv -NoTypeInformation

hardware_info.name: Hardware Info
hardware_info.command: $c = Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object -First 1; "CPU=$($c.Name)"; "Cores=$($c.NumberOfCores)"; "LogicalProcessors=$($c.NumberOfLogicalProcessors)"; "MaxClockMHz=$($c.MaxClockSpeed)"; $m = Get-CimInstance Win32_PhysicalMemory; "RAMModules=$(($m | Measure-Object).Count)"; "RAMGB=$([math]::Round((($m | Measure-Object -Property Capacity -Sum).Sum)/1GB,1))"; '[DISKS]'; Get-PhysicalDisk | Select-Object FriendlyName, MediaType, @{N='SizeGB';E={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,1)}}, HealthStatus | ConvertTo-Csv -NoTypeInformation

web_servers.name: Web Servers
web_servers.command: if (Get-Service W3SVC -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'IIS=RUNNING'; Import-Module WebAdministration -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; '[SITES]'; Get-Website | Select-Object Name, State, PhysicalPath | ConvertTo-Csv -NoTypeInformation } else { 'IIS=NOT_INSTALLED' }

databases.name: Databases
databases.command: foreach ($svc in @('MSSQLSERVER','MSSQL$*','MySQL*','postgresql*','MongoDB*','Redis*')) { Get-Service -Name $svc -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Status -eq Running | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Name)=RUNNING" } }

login_users.name: Local Users
login_users.command: Get-LocalUser | Where-Object Enabled | Select-Object Name, @{N='LastLogon';E={if ($_.LastLogon) { $_.LastLogon.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd') } else { '' }}}, PasswordExpires | ConvertTo-Csv -NoTypeInformation; '[GROUPS]'; foreach ($u in (Get-LocalUser | Where-Object Enabled)) { $names = @(); foreach ($grp in (Get-LocalGroup)) { if (Get-LocalGroupMember -Group $grp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "*\$($u.Name)" }) { $names += $grp.Name } }; if ($names) { "$($u.Name)=$($names -join ', ')" } }
